text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A meeting of the Council of Ministers said the pace of the extension of state administration into rebel-held areas was moving too slow. The meeting also addressed the return of striking teachers to work and a new salary scale for university professors.
- A climate of instability continues in the southeastern part of the Cabinda enclave, where factions of the FLEC-Renavado group are operating, the military said.
